en.headline: Fosun files Hong Kong listing for Club Med lifestyle group
en.dek: The mainland owner of Club Med said its ClubMed Lifestyle Group has applied to list on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Main Board.
body: Fosun International said ClubMed Lifestyle Group, a subsidiary that houses Club Med and related tourism businesses, has submitted a listing application to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong for a separate Main Board listing. The filing was announced on Friday. Joint sponsors are BNP Paribas, HSBC and J.P. Morgan.

According to the application materials cited by Fosun, Club Med is the group's core brand and operated 69 premium all-inclusive resorts worldwide. The group said that by business volume in 2025 Club Med was the world's largest all-inclusive resort brand. Revenue rose from 1.86 billion euros in 2023 to 1.95 billion euros in 2025, with adjusted EBITDA of 390 million euros and an adjusted EBITDA margin of 20.2 per cent in 2025.

The company said it expects to operate about 85 resorts worldwide by 2030. Proceeds from the proposed listing would be used mainly to expand the resort network, upgrade vacation offerings and strengthen digital and artificial-intelligence capabilities, with remaining funds for capital structure and daily operations.

Fosun took Club Med private after buying the French holiday operator in 2015 and withdrew it from the Paris exchange. Club Med chief executive Stephane Maquaire said the listing marked a step in the group's shareholding structure and would give the brand means to accelerate international development. ClubMed Lifestyle Group chairman Xu Xiaoliang described the Hong Kong filing as a milestone for Fosun's tourism business.

zh.headline: 復星為Club Med生活集團申請在港上市
zh.dek: 復星國際公布，旗下ClubMed Lifestyle Group已向香港聯交所提交主板獨立上市申請。
body: 復星國際公布，旗下涵蓋Club Med及相關旅遊業務的ClubMed Lifestyle Group，已向香港聯合交易所提交主板獨立上市申請，消息於周五發表。聯席保薦人為法國巴黎銀行、潕豐及摩根大通。
復星引述申請文件指，集團以Club Med為核心品牌，目前在全球營運69間高端全包式度假村，並稱按2025年業務量計算，Club Med是全球最大的全包式度假村品牌。收入由2023年的18.6億歐元增至2025年的19.5億歐元，2025年經調整EBITDA為3.90億歐元，經調整EBITDA利潤率為20.2%。
公司預期至2030年在全球營運約85間度假村。擬上市所得資金主要用作擴展度假村網絡、提升度假產品，以及加強數碼及人工智能能力，餘下資金則用於優化資本結構及日常營運。
復星2015年收購這家法國度假集團後將其私有化，並從巴黎交易所除牌。Club Med行政總裁Stéphane Maquaire表示，上市是股權結構演變的重要一步，有助加快國際發展。ClubMed Lifestyle Group主席徐曉亮形容今次在港遞表，是復星旅遊業務邁向價值創造的里程碑。
